# JUDO JSL Springboot Parent

> Parent POM for JUDO JSL Spring Boot applications — provides dependency versions, plugin configurations, code generation pipeline, and build lifecycle that child projects inherit.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ with Maven Wrapper
- Single parent POM (`<packaging>pom</packaging>`), no source code modules
- Code generation via Tatami JSL workflow: compiles `.jsl` model files into Java SDK classes, DAO interfaces, and Liquibase changelogs
- Model transformation pipeline: JSL to Platform Specific Model (PSM) to Architecture Specific Model (ASM) to RDBMS
- Dual database support: HSQLDB (development/testing) and PostgreSQL (production)
- Spring Boot 3.5.0, JUDO Runtime Core 1.0.6.x, JUDO Tatami JSL 1.1.4.x
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, bootstrap guide, and usage instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Full developer guide with build commands, technology stack, directory structure, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development environment setup and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD pipeline, branching strategy (GitFlow), and version numbering scheme

## Core

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): The parent POM — the sole artifact of this project; defines all dependency versions, plugin configurations, Maven profiles, and build lifecycle

## Depends on

- [judo-meta-liquibase](../../models/judo-meta-liquibase): Liquibase database change management metamodel
- [judo-dao-api](../../runtime/judo-dao-api): Core DAO interfaces for CRUD, query, navigation, and validation
- [judo-runtime-core](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core): Multi-module runtime engine — data access, business logic, REST, and security
- [judo-sdk-common](../../runtime/judo-sdk-common): Base classes for generated SDK — entity identity, DAO base, and query filters
- [judo-tatami-base](../../runtime/judo-tatami-base): PSM transformation pipeline — models to schemas, expressions, and configurations
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../../runtime/judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)
- [mapper](../../runtime/mapper): Type mapper and coercer library with 60+ built-in converters
- [epsilon-runtime](../../tools/epsilon-runtime): Eclipse Epsilon runtime for Maven and OSGi environments

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI workflow — build, deploy, tag, and create GitHub release
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): Manual release workflow — creates PRs for master and develop
- [logback-test.xml](logback-test.xml): Logback logging configuration used during test execution
- [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt): Eclipse Public License 2.0 license text
